script.spoken: Tenerife failed because ambiguous radio phrasing. It was the deadliest accident in aviation history: five hundred eighty three people died. Fog hid the runway, and one jet was still taxiing on it. The other began its take-off without clearance. A vague radio phrase sounded like permission. Two calls overlapped, and the warning was lost in noise. No machine failed that day. Aviation radio phrases were standardized afterward.
